Indikator 1 measures the proportion of patients receiving antibiotic treatment within three hours of arrival [^src3]. The national standard for this indicator is set at > 90% [^src1]. However, across all reporting periods and geographic levels, no region or hospital has successfully met this target [^src1].

In the 2022/23 reporting period, the national average in [[danmark|Danmark]] was 30.5%, up from 26.8% in 2021/22 and 23.0% in 2020/21 [^src1]. The most recent data from the 2024 report shows a slight further improvement, with the national average reaching 32.4% [^src3]. Despite this upward trend, performance remains significantly below the 90% threshold [^src1].

There is substantial geographic variation in performance. Among the regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] consistently leads, improving from 21.3% in 2020/21 to 39.8% in 2022/23 [^src1], and reaching 41.8% in the 2024 report [^src3]. Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] has seen a decline, dropping from 33.9% in 2020/21 to 32.7% in 2022/23 [^src1], and falling further to 25.9% in the 2024 report [^src3]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] remained relatively stable, moving from 27.1% to 31.8% and then 33.0% across the three periods [^src1] [^src3].

At the hospital level, leaders and trailers vary by reporting period. In the 2022/23 period, [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] was the top performer at 63.3%, a significant increase from 41.4% in 2020/21 [^src1]. [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] also performed well at 46.7% [^src2]. In the 2024 report, [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] led the listed hospitals at 48.8% [^src3]. On the lower end, [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] recorded the lowest proportion among all listed hospitals in the 2023 report at just 7.9% [^src2]. In the 2024 report, [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] was the lowest at 17.8% [^src3].

Several outliers are notable. [[nykoebing-f-sygehus|Nykøbing F Sygehus]] reported a 50.0% compliance rate in 2022/23, but this is based on a suppressed, very small sample size (indicated by "#/#" counts) and carries a massive 95% confidence interval of 1.3% to 98.7% [^src2]. Additionally, [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted]] recorded 0.0% across all measured periods in the 2023 data [^src2]. [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] also lagged significantly behind its peers in the capital region, achieving only 17.5% in 2022/23 [^src1].

Comprehensive methodological notes, extended regional breakdowns, and additional indicator analyses spanning the 2023 and 2024 reporting periods are detailed throughout the full registry publications [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24].
